first.rationale: Activation and onboarding are both declining, making onboarding simplification the most directly relevant intervention. Verify the durable SMB signup lift and the warning that shortened onboarding increases churn in complex workspaces. Run a segmented test for simple-workspace self-serve accounts while retaining the full flow for complex workspaces; avoid broad promotional pricing because its retention damage conflicts with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding simplification experiment for SMB and simple-workspace self-serve accounts, where signup simplification and shorter onboarding improved activation, completion, and time-to-value. Exclude complex-workspace accounts and retain their full onboarding because shortened flows increased 60-day churn by 9% there. Evaluate activation and completion alongside qualified revenue and 30-day retention to protect sustainable growth.
